records.name: Unbundledlicencerevenue
records.logic: sum(modelled unbundled licence units by type × their scenario price)
records.interpretation: Counts exclude copies/entitlements already included in partner or free access. Customer counts and prices remain assumptions.

records.name: Partnershiprevenue
records.logic: sum(modelled partner bundles × their scenario price)
records.interpretation: Define actual edition/work/use and includedbenefits. Do not separately resell/count bundled entitlement by assumption.

records.name: Incremental event cash
records.logic: sum(additional event-related cash costs not in common research-only case)
records.interpretation: Includes actual selected room/minimum/menu mechanics and timing. Do not add an entire menu total plus the same minimum spend when one offsets the other.

records.name: Operating contribution on cash-cost basis
records.logic: modelled revenue less defined attributable external cash costs
records.interpretation: Managerial operating measure, not bank cash or formal accounting recognition. Fulfilment and invoicing are separate from actual receipts/payments in FM08.

records.name: Full resource result
records.logic: modelled revenue less complete external cost and JGA/internal resource allocation, without duplicates
records.interpretation: Separate a stafftime allocation from extra cash. Explicit sharedresearch allocation and initialinvestment recovery view.

records.name: Remaining funding gap
records.logic: relevant fixed cost less net contribution of partner/other streams already included
records.interpretation: Do not add partner revenue or included licence contribution a second time. Positive gap/negativeunitcontribution handled explicitly.

records.name: Break-even additional licences
records.logic: if remaining funding gap <= 0: 0 additional licences; otherwise if unit contribution > 0: ceiling(gap / unit contribution); otherwise: no finite break-even
records.interpretation: First test whether the remaining gap is already covered. For a positive gap, a zero/negative unit contribution has no finite break-even. Use the selected licence type/mix and servicing cost; capacity can still make a numerical result infeasible.

records.name: Closing cash by month
records.logic: opening cash + actual-modelled receipts − cash payments
records.interpretation: Invoicevalue and revenuefulfilment are not cash receipts. Carry deposits/refunds/remaining obligations correctly, no doubleexpense.

records.name: Peak extra funding
records.logic: maximum positive cumulative cash deficit under the chosen startingcash/timing definition
records.interpretation: Initialinvestment already paid, remaining balance and future event exposures need separate views; no assumed sponsorreceipt.

records.name: Event increment versus research-only
records.logic: B result minus comparable A result over same horizon/common research basis
records.interpretation: Revenue uplift is a separate explicit scenario hypothesis. Do not ascribe all research sales to the dinner or force A to pay B-only feasibility/hospitality costs.
